svg.text: The Complete Genetic Profile: Real-Time Prevention + Detection + Post-Mortem Forensics
The Three Layers of Digital Footprint (Cyber DNA)
• File format (PE, ELF, Mach-O, PDF, Office)
"C2 pattern: Cobalt Strike beacon (17 min interval)"
Post-mortem: PCAP analysis reveals full timeline
Static DNA + Dynamic DNA + Network DNA = Persistent Genetic Fingerprint
Even if hash changes, behavior partially altered, or infrastructure shifts,
GENETIC MARKERS remain similar → Variant detection possible!
cyDNA: Three Operational Modes (NOT Just Post-Mortem!)
Email attachment, download, USB drive, network share
Extract file structure, code patterns, genetic markers
Result: "95% match to Emotet trojan family"
✓ DNA sent to threat intelligence for sharing
Examples: Cylance, Intezer Protect, Windows Defender
Malware begins executing (passed initial checks or fileless)
EDR monitors: API calls, memory ops, file changes, network
Examples: CrowdStrike IOAs, SentinelOne, Carbon Black
Breach discovered, need to understand scope and attribution
Collect: Memory dumps, files, PCAP, logs
✓ Create IOCs and signatures for future prevention
Examples: Intezer Analyze, VirusTotal, Hybrid Analysis
ANSWER: cyDNA is NOT Only for Post-Mortem!
Modern cyDNA Operates in ALL Three Modes Simultaneously
NOT the traditional web browsing/social media footprint!
Digital Footprint = Complete Behavioral & Structural Signature:
• Static Layer: File structure, code patterns, compilation artifacts
• Dynamic Layer: Runtime behavior, API sequences, memory operations
• Network Layer: Communication patterns, C2 infrastructure, protocol DNA
Genetic markers remain even if file is modified,
Real-time prevention, runtime detection, AND post-mortem forensics
cyDNA is predominantly PROACTIVE, with forensic bonus!
